observed_behavior: Publication and mainline tests exited successfully before running their publication assertions.
expected_behavior: Each selected scenario reaches and verifies its requested publication phases.
causal_mechanism: The automaticPublication flag selected an earlier increment-only Arc with an unconditional return. Later publication scenarios also set this flag, bypassing the batch, full-QA and mainline phases.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Combining mutually exclusive scenario flags while an earlier phase terminates the shared harness.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A successful earlier phase is reported as proof of later phases that never executed.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Requested publication phases cannot coexist with the earlier terminating increment-only scenario.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: The harness rejects the incompatible flag combination; publication callers select the complete Arc. The disposable rejection hook is removed after its own assertions and subsequent reconciliation uses the current stored graph digest.

applicability_conditions: A shared integration harness has an early-return scenario.
Later-phase tests accidentally enable that scenario as well.
confirmation_evidence: Removing the early return exposed a full-QA value mismatch, a retained fixture rejection hook and a stale graph digest.
After repairing the fixture boundaries, all seven selected real PostgreSQL publication/mainline tests execute successfully with zero skips.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-campaign-store.integration.test.ts: publication batch freezes one shared partial claim across concurrent requests and restart
tests/rolling-campaign-store.integration.test.ts: mainline race publication retains one observation and synchronizes the campaign after restart
